## Problem to solve

Describe the task you need to complete and why the current SDK, CLI, or MCP tools do not cover it.

## Current approach

What do you do today? Include only a minimal, public-safe example.

## Proposed behavior

Describe what would help. Mention whether it should be opt-in and which caller or transport would use it.

## Compatibility and boundaries

Would this affect existing SDK adapters, MCP clients, indexed data, provider calls, or repository permissions? Call out any constraints you know.
